bfsi.reason: ATT&CK: active since 2023, focused on theft of cryptocurrency and user credentials from developers and crypto-related individuals via fake job interviews.

description: Contagious Interview is a North Korea–aligned threat group active since 2023. The group conducts both cyberespionage and financially motivated operations, including the theft of cryptocurrency and user credentials. Contagious Interview targets Windows, Linux, and macOS systems, with a particular focus on individuals engaged in software development and cryptocurrency-related activities.
